overview.about: LIV Golf Hong Kong is played at the historic Hong Kong Golf Club at Fanling, a colonial-era course tucked into the New Territories. Its tight, tree-lined fairways and small greens make it a strategic test in the heart of one of Asia's great cities.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf Hong Kong is decided over 54 holes at Fanling, individual and team titles together. The classic parkland layout rewards accuracy over power on a course far shorter than most modern venues.
